worldcombat.skill.eerieimpulse.summary: Radiate a ring of eerie energy that temporarily lowers nearby enemies’ Sp. Atk. It needs no aim and interference passes through cover. Overloading widens its reach but lengthens the cast and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.eerieimpulse.use.0: Scramble every special attacker around you when they close in
worldcombat.skill.eerieimpulse.use.1: Cut a whole ring of Sp. Atk without aiming in a melee
worldcombat.skill.eerieimpulse.use.2: Win the first exchange so anyone who closes cannot hit special
worldcombat.skill.eerieimpulse.descripti: Lower nearby enemies’ Sp. Atk by %1$s stages for %2$s. It returns when the interference ends or is cleansed. The interference does not stack.
The field spreads %1$s blocks from the caster (counting air and ground alike) and only affects enemies inside it; no aiming and no line of sight are needed.
worldcombat.skill.eerieimpulse.timing: Range %1$s blocks, telegraph %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.eerieimpulse.preferenc: Off (steady): faster to discharge and a shorter cooldown, keeping the base radius and stat drop. On (overload): radius about x1.25 and denser arcs (about x1.3), but +3 ticks of telegraph and +25 ticks of cooldown.
Only consider the field when a threat is within this distance; smaller keeps it to grappling range, larger chases in first.

Only discharge when at least this many worthwhile enemies stand inside the real field (visible, hostile, using Sp. Atk and not floor-capped); larger reserves it for being surrounded, set 1 to fire on sight.
On: the companion will leave a hold position to discharge the field.
